name: value_latest_and_at_date
query: SELECT account, value(sum(position)) AS latest, value(sum(position), 2016-12-31) AS at_2016_end WHERE account ~ '^Assets:US:Vanguard:' AND account != 'Assets:US:Vanguard:Cash' GROUP BY account ORDER BY account
notes: value() converts each lot to its cost currency at the market price.
